title: Game-day availability in the owner's order
objective: Give the Model one reader of each player's availability at a decision time in the owner's order (OWN-073): on the player's game day, ESPN's fantasy status read within 15 minutes is final (OWN-064, it carries inactives); otherwise the freshest copy of NFL's injury report, Arbit's own twice-daily capture (OWN-063) or nflverse's republication through the point-in-time reader; otherwise unknown, never assumed active (R-066). Normalize status and practice wording across sources and label every value's source, known-from time and basis. No feature, service or API change.
next_action: Merge the PR for claude/m3-reader-speed-availability (TASK-20261123-002 and -003). Then M3 slice 3b under a model-class task: team environment and defense against the position (OWN-068) on the columnar reader; weather W1 beside it.

review.summary: Owner direction 2026-11-23: 'Previously weve tested Active List and Injury data from both ESPN and NFL. We should have a better route for more up to date injuries, however game day decisions should be the final say.' Read OWN-063 (NFL injury report twice daily for weekly game status), OWN-064 (ESPN fantasy status is the game-day input; current only within 15 minutes of a read), arbit_data.availability (capture index captures.jsonl with observedAt; the gameStatus table holds the whole season's report per capture; espn_status.status_as_of keyed by Arbit entity IDs). Real data, read-only: three NFL captures since 2026-11-22 23:43 UTC; the NFL capture and nflverse's injuries_2026 carry the same report (identical counts: 712 OUT, 762 QUESTIONABLE, 61 DOUBTFUL) in different wording (DIDNOT vs 'Did Not Participate In Practice'); ESPN's league document lists 1,063 pool players (1,031 athletes) with codes ACTIVE, INJURY_RESERVE, QUESTIONABLE, OUT, DOUBTFUL or none; entity_alias holds 18,875 current GSIS aliases.

plan.summary: New arbit_model.availability: availability(source, pit, season, week, at, game_day) returns a frame per GSIS ID with status, practice, source, _known_from, _basis and final, plus lineage. Layers: nflverse injuries through PointInTime; the latest NFL capture finished before the decision without an injuries error; between those two copies of the same report the fresher known-from wins per player (NFL on a tie); on game day, when ESPN is current, ESPN's status replaces them and is final; on game day without a current ESPN read the lineage says game-day status unknown. Vocabulary: status upper-case codes, practice FULL/LIMITED/DNP. is_game_day(game, at) helper. StoredAvailability reads captures.jsonl and the object store under ARBIT_AVAILABILITY_PATH, ESPN status through status_as_of and the GSIS alias map. Unit tests with fakes; a read-only audit on real data before and on game day; docs: OWN-073, ADR-007 implementation note, R-070 update, plan, status, changelog.

implementation.summary: New arbit_model.availability: availability(source, pit, season, week, at, game_day) with nflverse injuries through PointInTime, the latest successful NFL capture before the decision, freshest-copy merge per player (capture on a tie), and on game day a current ESPN status that replaces them and is final; StoredAvailability reads captures.jsonl, capture manifests and ESPN status (status_as_of, GSIS athlete aliases); is_game_day helper; status and practice vocabulary normalized. Tests (5) and a read-only audit script with receipt. Docs: OWN-073, ENG-055, ADR-007 availability note, R-070, research note section, README, plan, status, changelog.

journal.note: Real data (read-only): week 11 Sunday kickoff inside R-068: ESPN last read 2026-11-10, game-day status flagged unknown, 282 players from nflverse by the game-day rule; Monday night game day at 19:34 UTC 2026-11-23: ESPN current (read 14 s earlier), 1,026 final statuses, 37 unmapped pool entries (32 D/ST, 5 athletes), 216 more from NFL's 17:00 UTC capture; same moment before game day: all 313 from NFL's capture, fresher than nflverse.
Availability test sensitivity: using captures after the decision fails 2 tests, using a stale ESPN status fails 1, letting the older report copy win fails 2; source restored byte-identical.
